summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the advanced packaging, HBM backend, OSAT, and memory package/test capacity node. This pass keeps one obvious direct OSAT reference name and prioritizes underfollowed small/mid-cap or niche equipment/test beneficiaries. The strongest Layer 1B exposures found are AMKR as a direct OSAT capacity anchor, CAMT as an advanced packaging/HBM inspection and metrology supplier with recent AI/HBM orders, FORM as a probe-card/test-interface supplier tied to HBM and DRAM test intensity, and KLIC as a thermo-compression/advanced assembly equipment supplier with AI, CPO, heterogeneous integration, and emerging HBM relevance. These are research candidates only, not recommendations.
